river_rows: Every owned exact RIVER information row, every legal action and every compatible declared opponent combo, including zero actual-prefix support. No chosen-hand subset replaces the inventory.
posterior: Sum chance times the SAME saved opponent's prefix realization reach across all hidden histories, grouped by legal own information and declared combo. Exclude own prefix reach. Normalize positive rows; retain zero support explicitly.
compatible_prior: Normalize declared positive range weights over combos compatible with own cards and public board. Public bets do not enter this local control. It is not a globally consistent replacement strategy or root EV.
combo_q: Evaluate the frozen own fine/restricted river suffix and saved opponent future at every compatible combo/history. Verify within-combo conditional continuation values agree, then mix those SAME combo-specific action values with actual posterior or compatible prior. No new maximization over hidden deals.
weighting: For each game/responding seat, normalize chance times both players' uniform-action full reach over own river decisions BEFORE actual-support filtering. Use the SAME positive-actual-support rows and weights in both range panels; do not renormalize after filtering.
local_cost: sum_i w_i max_a Q_i(a) - max_a sum_i w_i Q_i(a); sum groups only as a local diagnostic under the declared weighting, NEVER game EV loss, exploitability or retraining gain.
conflict: A supported group is strict conflicting when the intersection of per-row actions within 1e-9 chips of that row's legal maximum is empty. Report group denominators separately for each grouping; keep signed intervention changes.
controls: Actual-posterior mixture reconstructs original conditional Q; both target signs; compatible/blocker/normalization/history/menu/inventory guards. Fine-self singleton costs and conflicts are zero. Identical weights yield zero change. Static refinement cannot increase convex sharing cost beyond tolerance. No effect-size or favorable-result acceptance gate.
display_order: Actual-posterior declared-group local sharing cost descending then original group index. Display only; all rows/groups/panels retained.
clock_scope: Thin-script entry before numerical imports through complete original replay, analysis and writes; interpreter startup excluded.
failures: Refuse existing destinations; save each completed profile and partial/failure metadata before advancing. Preserve unfavorable and incomplete outcomes.
